newsitem.title: USA: GM strike idles 7,536 U.S., Mexican workers.
newsitem.headline: GM strike idles 7,536 U.S., Mexican workers.

text.p: General Motors Corp said Thursday it has laid off 7,536 GM North American employees in the United States and Mexico because of the two-week strike against its Canadian operations.
GM said 115 employees at its Livonia, Mich., engine plant were added to the list Thursday afternoon.
The total number reflects layoffs as of 1600 EDT/2000 GMT.
The company said 2,450 workers were still idled at its Cadillac assembly plant in Detroit.
About 1,790 workers remain idled at GM's Ypsilanti, Mich., transmission plant near Detroit, and 1,050 are idled at the North Tonawanda, N.Y., engine plant near Buffalo.
Several other plants in Michigan, Ohio and Mexico were also affected by the strike by the Canadian Auto Workers union.
GM said its next update on the impact of the strike in Canada was due on October 18 at 1100 EDT/1500 GMT.
